verdict.rationale: MotherDuck documents natural-language delegation: you can generate dashboards (Dives) from prompts and refine them conversationally while the Viewer updates in place. However, the evidence frames this as working through the remote MCP server and "your favorite agent" (external AI clients), not as a clearly built-in assistant inside the product. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of a native in-product AI assistant UI, delegation of tasks beyond analytics and dashboards, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
